question: Should OpenClaw change contextPruning.ttl to expire or summarize normal conversation history, or keep it tool-result-only and add a separate authorized session/context control contract?
rationale: The requested behavior would change documented retention semantics and may add privileged session mutation APIs, which automation should not choose without maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Define typed session/context contract
options.body: Create maintainer-approved semantics for pruning, compaction, reset, retention, authorization, persistence, recovery, and docs before adding transport endpoints.

options.title: Clarify existing behavior only
options.body: Document that contextPruning.ttl is tool-result-only and steer users to /compact, /new, /reset, and sessions.reset without adding conversation TTL pruning.

options.title: Retarget TTL semantics
options.body: Make contextPruning.ttl affect conversation history too, accepting a compatibility-sensitive change to the current pruning contract.

recommendation.title: Define typed session/context contract
recommendation.body: Create maintainer-approved semantics for pruning, compaction, reset, retention, authorization, persistence, recovery, and docs before adding transport endpoints.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is tied to the prior keep-open review, cache-TTL pruning history, and current session/thread API history.
